notes.title: Join our New Community Discord!
notes.content:
Hello, Heroes – I hope this transmission finds you well.

Now that we’ve announced our new game for Steam and confirmed cross-platform play, we know (from experience) that there’s nothing better than a dedicated space to get hyped together!

We’re excited to present the official Lucky Mountain Games Discord Server!

We always wanted to create a fun, chill, and informative place for our community to gather under one roof. In all honesty, we found other social platforms to be quite limiting for that goal; we (as gamers and indie developers) want to interact with players in real-time and share info directly with those who want to hear it.

In our Discord server, you can:

 Have discussions about our games with the community 
 Share your thoughts and ideas with us
 Register interest in upcoming playtests/betas  
 Participate in giveaways, events, and competitions 
 Show off your art & creative work
 Stay up-to-date about our games and our studio (no spam, we promise!)

Leap right into action through this permanent invite link:
https://discord.com/invite/6s3fWJskxe  

We can’t wait to see you there!  


P.S.: The first 10 members to join and introduce themselves will receive a special flair + chat colour to commemorate the launch of our Discord server.
